changes: Shared arithmetic calendar-to-epoch conversion uses Gregorian month prefixes after validation, avoiding repeated month-length scans. Rust recurring transition search rejects candidates that cannot improve the best transition before evaluating their rules. Original25 native matrix retained; seven named-zone cases added separately with full signed output parity.

profile.scope: Separate V8 CPU profile of zonedOffset,zonedAddDay,zonedDayStart,zonedHoursInDay,dateAdd,yearMonthAdd.100k warmup,5x200k. Public output parity; profile timings are not throughput measurements.

calendarControls.method: Four fresh TS processes parent/candidate/candidate/parent. Eight varying inputs with output parity.100000 warmup,9x100000 calls. No concurrent tests/builds/profiler. round is unchanged-path control. Only two named files swapped.

nativeTransitionControls.method: Four fresh native+TS processes parent/candidate/candidate/parent. Seven named-zone workloads,four inputs,full signed outputs checked. Native256 warmup,9x16384;TS20000 warmup,9x50000,transition1000 warmup,9x5000. Only crates/temporal/timezone.rs swapped; other current runtime changes held identical. No concurrent tests/builds/profiler. Other named operations unchanged-path controls.

nativeInputDiagnostics.method: Optimized per-input public API timing diagnostics, not hardware sampling. Each input9x16384 calls, black_box input and consumed result. Separate from matched production comparisons. Capture hashes include benchmark source before final whitespace formatting.

baseline.method: Original25 results: optimized native Rust APIs; four inputs, matched checksums before timing, 256 warmup, nine alternating samples. Parsed inputs and calendar registries initialized outside timing. Strings allocated and FNV-1a 32-bit hashed by both implementations. Calendar fields read as one aggregate in FormatJS, three public getters in temporal_rs. Harness checksum and black_box included. UTC/fixed-offset parsing only; no named-zone data, JS, FFI, JSON, cold startup or full-polyfill conformance comparison.
baseline.namedZoneMethod: Seven additional FormatJS Rust/TS workloads. Four inputs cover New York gap/fold, Lord Howe half-hour change and New York year2400. Compiled IANA registry initialized outside timing. Full signed i128 outputs; hoursInDay uses half-hours. No temporal_rs named-zone comparison.

initialNamedMatrix.method: Initial expanded matrix before Rust optimization, using current TS calendar shortcut and Rust at baseCommit. First sample found6/7 Rust wins; parent control repeats found7/7 because TS varied. The roughly2x native transition gain is consistent across controls.

validation.summary: 49 focused targets pass: eight full Node suites,16 pure-TS Hermes suites,10 native SDK Hermes suites,7 ICU/unit targets,5 package/type/export checks,3 Rust targets including independent ICU transition/offset oracles.

limits: Goal remains open. Original25 and named7 native matrices are separate; named7 has no temporal_rs comparison because benchmark provider supports UTC only. Registry setup, cold startup and Hermes bindings excluded from native throughput. JS48 is ISO/Gregorian; reference samples frozen from preceding checkpoint. Close cases and prior rounding variability require final fresh repeated comparisons. Calendar numeric shortcut keeps validation before arithmetic. No new caches or timezone data.
